question: T Balasaraswati, a ___________ dancer was also an actress.
solution:
Correct Answer **Bharatanatyam**

The famous dancer T Balasaraswati was an exponent of __Bharatanatyam.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**

__
 
• Bharatanatyam a classical dance style that originated in Tamil Nadu's South Indian state, making this dance style well known in various parts of India and many parts of the world.
 
• In 1957 she was awarded the Padma Bhushan and in 1977 the Padma Vibhushan.
 
• She received the Sangeetha Kalasikhamani Award from The Indian Fine Arts Society, Chennai, in 1981.
 
• She was the only non-western dancer included in a Dance Heritage Coalition compilation, "The Irreplaceable Treasures of Dance in America: The First 100" (2000).
 
• Satyajit Ray, Bengali film director, made a documentary film on Balasaraswati called Bala (1976).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Classical dance**

 
• Classical dances are performed by professional or highly trained dancers who have studied their form for many years.
 
• There are eight classical Dances in India.
 
• Classical dance expresses a story or theme and this form of art lies in the religious Hindu music theatre styles. It represents the culture.
 
• They are
 
 
• Kathak from North India,
 
• Sattriya of Assam,
 
• Bharatnatyam of Tamil Nadu,
 
• Kuchipudi of Andhra Pradesh,
 
• Kathakali and Mohiniaattam of Kerala,
 
• Manipuri of Northeast India, and
 
• Odissi of Odisha.
 
 
 
• It is the right way to connect with your feelings, coordinate and move the movement skills and build strength and stability in your body.
